---
title: "kudlen"
---

## Description

Change variable length to the maximum length of value in it.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the input dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`outds`**

: Name of output dataset

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `&inds`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%kudlen(dm);
```
